$comment: Jalsa — QR dine-in ordering (UniqBrio/JalsaRestaurant, the Next.js app in jalsa/). Three surfaces:
guest (/t/<table>, no sign-in), captain (/staff) and owner (/owner), the last two behind ONE
four-digit PIN keypad with a session per surface — hence pin-only with a loginPath per account.
Production is not provisioned (jalsa/docs/registers/ENVIRONMENTS.md), so baseUrl is local
development. Seeded PINs (1234) are provisional and only open 'choose your own PIN': an account
needs its own PIN before it can be captured. Read-only: dataIsolation none.
appDescription: QR dine-in ordering for one restaurant: guests order from their table, captains work the floor, the owner runs the till.

owner.description: The owner console. A real account — permanently READ-ONLY.

captain.description: A captain's handset. Optional: its flows are skipped until set.
